Here's the current MCC pin mapping for **firmware/guitar** (PIC32CM6408PL10048):

## T1S / SPI (SERCOM0 → LAN8651)
| Pin | Pin ID | Name | Function | Dir |
|-----|--------|------|----------|-----|
| 48 | PA04 | T1S_MOSI | SERCOM0_PAD0 | — |
| 1 | PA05 | T1S_SCK | SERCOM0_PAD1 | — |
| 3 | PA07 | T1S_MISO | SERCOM0_PAD3 | — |
| 19 | PA15 | T1S_CS | GPIO | Out (high) |
| 18 | PA14 | T1S_RST | GPIO | Out (high) |
| 17 | PA13 | T1S_IRQ_N | EIC_EXTINT13 | In/Out |

## CDC / CLI UART (SERCOM1)
| Pin | Pin ID | Name | Function | Dir |
|-----|--------|------|----------|-----|
| 4 | PB00 | CDC_TX | SERCOM1_PAD0 | — |
| 5 | PB01 | CDC_RX | SERCOM1_PAD1 | — |

| Pin | Pin ID | Name |
|-----|--------|------|
| 25 | PA21 | FRET_RED |
| 26 | PA22 | FRET_GREEN |
| 10 | PA08 | FRET_YELLOW |
| 11 | PA09 | FRET_BLUE |
| 6 | PB02 | FRET_ORANGE |

## Strum outputs (GPIO, out, latch low)
| Pin | Pin ID | Name |
|-----|--------|------|
| 7 | PB03 | STRUM_UP |
| 22 | PA18 | STRUM_DOWN |

## Switch inputs (GPIO, in)
| Pin | Pin ID | Name |
|-----|--------|------|
| 13 | PA11 | SW3 |
| 16 | PA12 | SW2 |
| 36 | PA26 | SW1 |
